findings.detail: LangChain create_agent assigns the source name to the native compiled graph.
A compiled LangGraph agent has no description property. The adapter retains the description in its agent catalog (artifact metadata) for discovery and diagnostics; it never enters the prompt.
The Markdown body is supplied through create_agent(system_prompt=...) on every model turn.
The external binding explicitly attests this capability for the injected LangChain model.
The external binding explicitly attests this capability for the injected LangChain model.
The binding does not attest preferred capability 'vision-input'.

The framework has no Agent Skills concept. The adapter supplies the dedicated tool activation pattern of the Agent Skills integration guide: catalog in the tool description, full body returned on demand as a tool result.
Activated skill content enters context as a tool result. Whether it survives context compaction or summarization for the rest of the session was not exercised.
Agent Skills requires references, scripts, and assets to be reachable on demand. The fixture skills bundle no resources, so on-demand resource access was not exercised.
The remote research MCP server was not activated during deterministic construction; no plugin tool is silently substituted.
LangGraph has no agent relationship primitive. The adapter-authored StructuredTool implements the draft 0.1 contract: fresh child run, task in, text out, control returns to the parent.
